name: lumora
description: Turn screen recordings, screenshots or a website into cinematic product demo videos.

interface.longDescription: Lumora turns a screen recording, a screenshot or a public website into a short product demo video: a 3D camera move over your interface, callouts that point at features, captions, a device frame, a title card, music and a call to action. Ask for a launch video, a changelog clip or a vertical social video of the app you are building. Preview frames before exporting, then get an MP4, GIF or WebM with a share link. Lumora edits your own footage with motion graphics; it does not generate imagery with an AI model.
defaultPrompt: Make a 12 second launch video of https://example.com with Lumora
Turn demo.mp4 into a vertical Reels video with captions
Screenshot the dashboard and make a Lumora trailer in our brand colours

positive.prompt: Make a 15 second launch video of https://lumora.video with Lumora, in a clean light style with a call to action at the end.
positive.expected_behavior: Lumora screenshots the page, creates a project with a title card, callouts and the call to action, returns an editor link and shows a preview frame. Nothing is exported yet.

positive.prompt: Turn this dashboard screenshot into a 10 second vertical feature video with Lumora, with two short callouts on the main numbers.
positive.expected_behavior: The screenshot is uploaded, a vertical (9:16) project is created with two callouts placed on the dashboard, and a preview frame is shown with an editor link.

positive.prompt: List my Lumora videos and show me the details of Spring launch.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the account's projects (including Spring launch) and summarises Spring launch: length, format, title, tagline, callouts and camera.

positive.prompt: In my Lumora video Spring launch, change the tagline to "Product demos in minutes", slow the camera down, then export it as an MP4.
positive.expected_behavior: Updates the project, starts the export and checks its progress until it finishes (2 to 4 minutes), then returns the MP4 download link and a public share link.

positive.prompt: Save a Lumora brand kit called Review with the colours #6D5DFC, #A78BFA and #111111, then use it for a new video of https://lumora.video.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves the brand kit for the team and creates a new project that uses its colours, returning the editor link.

negative.description: AI-generated footage is out of scope: Lumora only animates media the user provides, so the assistant should explain that and offer a demo video from a screenshot, recording or website instead of calling create_video with invented footage.
negative.prompt: Generate a realistic AI video of a person presenting my product on stage.

negative.description: Unrelated writing task: no Lumora tool should be called, the assistant just writes the text itself.
negative.prompt: Write a 300 word blog post announcing our spring product launch.

negative.description: Bulk deletion is not something the plugin offers: there is no delete tool, so the assistant should not change any project and should point the user to deleting videos in the Lumora app.
negative.prompt: Delete all of my Lumora videos.
